distance_note: Distances are calibrated to the journey path: each leg is the arc length between its map anchors, scaled so the full route is 1,779 mi. Named places use canonical marker coordinates; intermediate anchors are path points. Legs target 80–200 km.

beats.arrival: The road goes ever on. The Shire’s hedgerows close behind you.
beats.departure: Woody End at dusk. The Brandywine is still ahead.

beats.arrival: The Brandywine glimmers through the trees.
beats.departure: A ferry across the river, and the Shire is behind you.

beats.arrival: The Old Forest is behind you. Lights ahead: Bree.
beats.departure: A warm inn, a cold drink. Strider joins the party.

beats.arrival: The climb begins — incline bonus country.
beats.departure: Fire on the hilltop. Run.

beats.arrival: Troll country. Mind the stones.
beats.departure: The Last Bridge is behind you. The Bruinen is near.

legs.name: The Last Bridge to the Ford

beats.arrival: The river is loud, and the Ford is close.
beats.departure: The Ford of Bruinen behind you — the sanctuary ahead.

beats.arrival: The valley opens. Rivendell, at last.
beats.departure: The Council is over. The road south begins.

beats.arrival: The wilds of Eregion. Hollin under the sky.
beats.departure: The mountains close in. The Redhorn waits.

beats.arrival: Snow and stone. The pass is high and cold.
beats.departure: The Redhorn Gate behind you. Moria is below.

beats.arrival: The doors close. Drums in the deep.
beats.departure: Over the Bridge of Khazad-dûm — sprint beat. Daylight again.

beats.arrival: Golden wood. The mirror shows how far you’ve walked.
beats.departure: Gifts from Galadriel. The river waits.

beats.arrival: The Silverlode runs bright beside the road.
beats.departure: The river bends south. The Great River takes you.

beats.arrival: Sarn Gebir. Rocks in the water; keep steady.
beats.departure: The rapids are behind you. The Argonath ahead.

beats.arrival: Two kings in stone. The Argonath.
beats.departure: The Great River narrows. Rauros roars.

beats.arrival: The falls roar ahead. The fellowship breaks.
beats.departure: Choose your companion perk for the final stretch.

beats.arrival: Two small figures, one vast wilderness.
beats.departure: Don’t follow the lights. Steady pace, no stops.

legs.name: Emyn Muil to the Black Gate

beats.arrival: The marshes release you. The gate looms.
beats.departure: The Black Gate is behind you. The Eye is watching.

beats.arrival: Ash and fire. Every march here earns bonus XP.
beats.departure: The plateau opens. Barad-dûr glitters far off.

beats.arrival: The Ash Plains. No cover, no water, no rest.
beats.departure: The mountain grows. One last climb.

legs.name: The Ash Plains to Mount Doom

beats.arrival: Mount Doom’s foothills. The air burns.
beats.departure: The final mile — best walked in one march.

legs.name: Mount Doom to the Sammath Naur

beats.arrival: The Sammath Naur. The fire is close.
beats.departure: It is done. Credits: every mile, every day. Now walk home.
